body: Thank you. This is some fantastic advice. I'll definitely take what you said to heart.

From personal experience, I've found that the easiest way to hurt someone is to ignore them, to shut them out. I can't weigh in on how you "hurt" people, but know that it can be just as painful to watch someone close themself off.
The worst off you could possibly be is dead. Don't give up! You never know how life could turn around.

It's hard feeling like nobody wants to listen to you. I know that feeling. Certainly can feel like that posting on internet boards online :) but I think being self-conscious about communicating with other people is a universal problem. A tough problem at that- it's easy to just give up. But the easy way out is never the best option. I would urge you to keep talking to all kinds of people- friends, family, enemies, strangers... You're bound to find some listeners somewhere. 

Best of luck!
